_comment: Worked A->B-diagonal coverage example. A (start) and B (goal) are OPPOSITE CORNERS of the rectangle's diagonal -- they are NOT a straight driving line. workspace_width_m is the short side and MUST be shorter than the A->B diagonal (~8.6 m here). The planner derives the long side as sqrt(diagonal^2 - width^2) and lays serpentine lanes spaced step_spacing_m apart. Every key is a build_preview() kwarg, so this file loads directly via cli.load_planner_config().
